input.head: stack/wave-selection-01
input.title: Restore source wave counts and table-index selection
input.body:
## Summary

Wave generation chose an option before rolling its counts, then filtered prior tank IDs into a floor-sampled pool. The recovered source prepares every available count first, uses a rounded chance ticket, and rejects repeated table indices within the same KEY.

```text
prepare all option counts → rounded ticket → KEY lookup / index rejection → spawn copies
```

This is layer 1 of the next five-layer stack, based on merged master `0736578`. Keep master held until all five layers are assembled into the final PR. The following layer restores enemy construction before pose draws.

## Evidence

- **Before:** three new regressions fail. A finite raw-0.499 singleton witness emits four enemies using five draws.
  **After:** the source contract emits five enemies using six draws; rounded selection, retry consumption, singleton draw suppression and KEY reset pass.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 918 unit tests / 8,464 assertions pass. Production build and all 12 affected mock/supplied-SWF browser cases pass without skips, flaky results or page errors. Both accelerated pilots reach boss defeat and Continue; these are seeded fixtures, not ordinary progression.
- Independent exported-pcode template audit passes 1,344 distance/profile cases and visits all 99 constructor sites. Controlled threshold/chance mutations and unknown instructions are rejected. The bounded walker does not execute AVM2 or prove runtime equivalence.
- Constant-RNG lifecycle fixtures now cache unrelated empty destinations; every assertion remains. The saved-enemy caller keeps its two-copy assertion using the normal seed-10 route instead of seed 6.
- Rebase onto the tested master merge changes documentation only. Source identities, exact commands, build and coverage limits are in [the wave reference](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/blob/stack/wave-selection-01/docs/wave-selection-reference.md).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

No saved-data migration or bundled original media.

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

Encounter composition and subsequent RNG consumption change. Offline roster policy, missing-key handling, complete constructor/art RNG and ordinary original/Adobe boss-win parity remain unfinished. The branch uses the existing `stack/**` Vercel deployment control; provider-confirmed skipping is not inferred from an absent status.

Created with gpt-6.1-sol in T3 Code's Codex harness, including earlier gpt-6.1-sol source-audit and validation contributions.

input.head: stack/wave-selection-02-birth-order
input.title: Finish enemy Setup before assigning field positions
input.body:
## Summary

Fresh-field enemies consumed random X/Y coordinates before their weapons and behaviors finished Setup. The recovered field loader constructs each tank first, then draws X, Y and rotation. This layer restores that order and makes spawner births assign their supplied coordinates after construction as well.

```diff
fresh enemy
- draw X/Y → construct / Setup → draw rotation
+ construct / Setup → draw X/Y/rotation → attach
```

Layer 2 of the five-layer stack, based on [#135](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/135). Only this layer's four files appear in the diff. Assemble all five layers into the last PR and validate that combined head before one master merge; do not merge this layer into master individually.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new builtin-boss regression fails because acquisition/selection draws occur after the X draw.
  **After:** both retained fighter choices and final coordinates pass, with all Setup draws before the X/Y/rotation suffix. Existing cross-field parent/callback and first-Run contracts still pass.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 919 unit tests / 8,471 assertions pass.
- Production build and all 14 affected mock/supplied-art browser cases pass with zero skips, flaky results or page errors: actors, crossing, accelerated progression, ink, mounted targets and public creator/save/source selection. Both accelerated pilots reach six upgrades, boss defeat, badge and Continue (72,034 mock / 71,183 supplied-art frames). Owned servers stopped; native history/win/targeting paint inspected.
- Matching AS/pcode for field creation and SpawnNewEnemy establish the order. [The source reference](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/blob/stack/wave-selection-02-birth-order/docs/cross-field-weapons-reference.md#field-births-finish-construction-before-their-display-pose) records hashes, commands and limits. The code tree is unchanged by rebasing onto #135's merged-master base.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

No saved-data migration or original media.

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

Random-stream ordering and spawn-time state change. These scoped tests do not prove every original constructor/art draw, display-setter precision, ordinary earned boss-win or original/Adobe/full-game equivalence. The branch retains the existing `stack/**` deployment control.

Created with gpt-6.1-sol in T3 Code's Codex harness.
